w: Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir for women. The previous day, a yagna was performed and a procession of the murtis was carried out in the town. More than 4,000 devotees and well wishers participated.
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha at the newly constructed Swaminarayan Mandir in Nehrul, New Mumbai.
In the evening Swamishri travelled to Sahara Lake City, about 120 kms from Mumbai .
At 10.00 a.m. Swamishri made an observation tour of the Akshardham site.
In the evening Swamishri attended the satsang assembly in which Pujya Adarshjivan Swami elaborated upon the Shrimad Bhagvad Gita. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly in Hindi.

2004.o: Prabodhini Ekadashi and Swamishri's 66th Diksha Anniversary
w: At 7.10 pm Swamishri performed the shakotsav arti of Thakorji. A variety of fresh vegetable had been displayed before the deities. During the evening satsang assembly Swamishri underlined the meaning of true living.
Six youths performed prostrations from Samadhiyala.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of the murtis for new BAPS hari mandirs in Charvi (Vansda district, Navsari), Jamalpor (Navsari region) and Nimeta (Vadodara rural region).

Arabella Stagg, wife of Richard Stagg, the British High Commissioner to India, and Jill Beckingham, wife of Deputy High Commissioner Peter Beckingham, came today, after darshan at the Bochasan mandir, to have darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj from afar. In particular, the Deputy High Commissioner's wife was to walk for seventeen days along Gandhiji's Dandi route, and the High Commissioner's wife was to accompany her for three days. Their noble aim was to raise funds to educate poor children. They had stayed at our mandir in Dabhan. Last night too they had stayed at our mandir in Borsad. Staying in the home caravan with them, they were using the grounds of our mandirs. On learning that Swamishri was staying in Bochasan, they arrived here early in the morning with a special wish for darshan.

When Swamishri, having finished his morning routine, came out, they had the benefit of Swamishri's darshan, sitting at a distance near the thal and gifts office. On behalf of the organisation they were welcomed with Thakorji's sanctified garlands. After having darshan of Swamishri from afar, they exclaimed, "I believe that God is present in Swamiji."
Expressing this experience of their first darshan of Swamishri, they said to the volunteers with them, "I will always keep this sanctified garland that has been given to me."
